properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Secure entropy source of the shipped web3-cmt.js bundle: the vendored BigNumber.js config() honors a CRYPTO flag that, when enabled, draws all random digits from crypto.getRandomValues (browser) or crypto.randomBytes (Node) instead of Math.random. This is the RNG behind any random-value generation the client library performs. Rating '?' arose because the collector could not tell CSPRNG from its caller; the sites themselves are unambiguously the secure API.
